template.title: The Rainbow Toy Rescue
template.summary: A child and a friendly animal rescue a toy that falls into a puddle, discovering a rainbow surprise along the way.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with [[slot_toy]] in the park.
One sunny day, the [[slot_toy]] slipped off the swing and fell into a puddle.
[[slot_child]] felt sad and wondered where the toy would go.
Then a friendly [[slot_pet]] hopped over and nudged the toy with its nose.
The toy popped up, and a bright [[slot_color]] rainbow sprouted from its top.
[[slot_child]] gasped and laughed, amazed by the rainbow.
But the toy was still wet, and [[slot_child]] thought to dry it on the bench.
[[slot_child]] almost left the toy there, but then remembered the park's shade.
So [[slot_child]] carried the toy under the big tree and let the sun dry it.
After a few minutes, the toy was dry and the rainbow faded.
[[slot_child]] thanked the [[slot_pet]] and they both played with the toy again.
The day ended with a gentle [[slot_sound]] of birds singing, and [[slot_child]] felt happy.
